nodes.description: Mapping of token balances per address declared in BasicToken and mutated by burn, transfer, burnFrom, transferFrom and the constructor.
Total token supply; decreased by burn/burnFrom and set once in the KugulaToken constructor.
Accumulated amount of burned tokens, increased by burn and burnFrom.
Nested allowance mapping owner => spender => amount in StandardToken, written by approve/increaseApproval/decreaseApproval and decremented by burnFrom/transferFrom.
Constant 2**256-1 used to skip allowance bookkeeping for infinite approvals.
Token name, 'Kugula'.
Token symbol, 'KGL'.
Token decimals, 18.
Caller-controlled address used as balance owner, allowance spender, burner and initial supply receiver.
BasicToken.burn: requires _value <= balances[msg.sender], subtracts from balances/totalSupply_ and adds to burnedTotalNum_.
BasicToken.transfer: sends _value to _to, or delegates to burn when _to is address(0).
StandardToken.burnFrom: burns _value from _owner using msg.sender allowance and updates supply counters.
StandardToken.transferFrom: moves tokens using allowance, or delegates to burnFrom when _to is address(0).
StandardToken.approve: overwrites allowed[msg.sender][_spender] with _value.
StandardToken.increaseApproval: adds _addedValue to the caller's allowance for _spender.
StandardToken.decreaseApproval: subtracts _subtractedValue from the caller's allowance, flooring at zero.
KugulaToken constructor: sets totalSupply_ and credits the whole supply to msg.sender.
Returns balances[_owner].
Returns totalSupply_.
Returns burnedTotalNum_.
Returns allowed[_owner][_spender].

edges.reason: burn reads balances[msg.sender] and uses msg.sender as the burner address, so authorization depends on the caller.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], making the caller the implicit account owner.
burnFrom checks allowed[_owner][msg.sender], so the caller must be an approved spender.
transferFrom checks allowed[_from][msg.sender], tying the spender role to the caller.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender], so the allowance owner is the caller.
increaseApproval writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender], so the caller owns the allowance.
decreaseApproval writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender], so the caller owns the allowance.
constructor assigns the entire initial supply to balances[msg.sender].
burn decreases balances[burner] by _value.
burn decreases totalSupply_ by _value.
burn increases burnedTotalNum_ by _value.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] and credits balances[_to].
burnFrom decreases balances[_owner] by _value.
burnFrom decreases allowed[_owner][msg.sender] unless the approval is MAX_UINT.
burnFrom decreases totalSupply_ by _value.
burnFrom increases burnedTotalNum_ by _value.
transferFrom debits balances[_from] and credits balances[_to].
transferFrom decreases allowed[_from][msg.sender] unless the approval is MAX_UINT.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
increaseApproval adds _addedValue to allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
decreaseApproval reduces or clears allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
constructor sets totalSupply_ to the fixed initial amount.
constructor credits the full supply to balances[msg.sender].
balanceOf reads balances[_owner].
totalSupply returns the value of totalSupply_.
totalBurned returns the value of burnedTotalNum_.
allowance reads allowed[_owner][_spender].
transfer returns burn(_value) when _to == address(0), redirecting execution to burn.
transferFrom returns burnFrom(_from, _value) when _to == address(0), redirecting execution to burnFrom.
_value parameter flows into the burn amount checks and subtractions.
_to parameter decides the transfer recipient and whether the burn path is taken.
_value parameter is the transferred amount in transfer.
_owner parameter selects the account debited by burnFrom.
_value parameter is the burned amount in burnFrom.
_from parameter selects the debited account in transferFrom.
_to parameter decides the credit destination and whether burnFrom is called.
_value parameter is the moved amount in transferFrom.
_spender parameter indexes the allowance mapping written by approve.
_value parameter is the allowance amount set by approve.
_spender parameter indexes the allowance mapping updated by increaseApproval.
_addedValue parameter is added to the allowance in increaseApproval.
_spender parameter indexes the allowance mapping updated by decreaseApproval.
_subtractedValue parameter is compared and subtracted in decreaseApproval.
_owner parameter is used as the key into balances in balanceOf.
_owner parameter is the outer key into allowed in allowance.
_spender parameter is the inner key into allowed in allowance.
local variable burner caches msg.sender and is used for balance reads and writes in burn.
local variable oldValue caches the current allowance and drives the branch in decreaseApproval.
burn performs SafeMath sub on balances[burner] and totalSupply_, a value-decreasing arithmetic operation.
burn performs SafeMath add on burnedTotalNum_, a value-increasing arithmetic operation.
transfer performs SafeMath sub on balances[msg.sender].
transfer performs SafeMath add on balances[_to].
burnFrom performs SafeMath sub on balances[_owner], allowed and totalSupply_.
burnFrom performs SafeMath add on burnedTotalNum_.
transferFrom performs SafeMath sub on balances[_from] and on allowed[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom performs SafeMath add on balances[_to].
increaseApproval performs SafeMath add on allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
decreaseApproval performs SafeMath sub on allowed[msg.sender][_spender] in the else branch.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _value of burn only feeds the balance/supply subtractions, so it is normalized into the burn function node.
Parameter _to of transfer is only used as recipient/index and the zero-address branch, so it is normalized into transfer.
Parameter _value of transfer only feeds the transfer arithmetic, so it is normalized into transfer.
Parameter _owner of burnFrom is only used as a balances/allowed key, so it is normalized into burnFrom.
Parameter _value of burnFrom only feeds the burn arithmetic, so it is normalized into burnFrom.
Parameter _from of transferFrom is only used as a balances/allowed key, so it is normalized into transferFrom.
Parameter _to of transferFrom is only used as recipient and zero-address check, so it is normalized into transferFrom.
Parameter _value of transferFrom only feeds the transfer arithmetic, so it is normalized into transferFrom.
Parameter _spender of approve only indexes the allowed mapping, so it is normalized into approve.
Parameter _value of approve is directly stored into the allowance, so it is normalized into approve.
Parameter _spender of increaseApproval only indexes the allowed mapping, so it is normalized into increaseApproval.
Parameter _addedValue of increaseApproval is the operand of the SafeMath add, so it is normalized into that unsafe_operation.
Parameter _spender of decreaseApproval only indexes the allowed mapping, so it is normalized into decreaseApproval.
Parameter _subtractedValue of decreaseApproval is the operand of the SafeMath sub, so it is normalized into that unsafe_operation.
Parameter _owner of balanceOf only indexes the balances mapping, so it is normalized into balanceOf.
Parameter _owner of allowance only indexes the allowed mapping, so it is normalized into allowance.
Parameter _spender of allowance only indexes the allowed mapping, so it is normalized into allowance.
Local variable burner is just a cached copy of msg.sender inside burn and is normalized into burn.
Local variable oldValue is just a cached allowance value inside decreaseApproval and is normalized into decreaseApproval.
